'''Tenzigo Weems''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Signal Intelligence (Rebel Alliance)|Signals Intelligence]] [[Rebel technician|technician]] in [[General]] [[Davits Draven]]'s command at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s headquarters in the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]], where he was part of a team of analysts deciphering communications chatter from across [[the galaxy]].<ref name="UVG" /> He analyzed a packet of data intercepted from the [[Balmorra]] relay that contained the names of classified [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] projects and reported his findings to Draven.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> [[Private]] Weems tracked the progress of [[Operation Fracture]] from [[Jedha]] to [[Eadu]],<ref name="UVG" /> and alerted [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] when an intercepted Imperial transmission revealed that the [[squad]] [[Rogue One]] had instigated the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Later, he picked up a signal from [[Lieutenant]] [[Caluan Ematt]], in which Ematt stated that his unit, the [[Shrikes]], had been [[Ambush on Taanab|eliminated]] by [[Alecia Beck]] and the [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]], and that he was stuck on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Cyrkon]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
Weems was portrayed by [[Eric MacLennan]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' and was credited as Rebel Technician #1.<ref name="Rogue One" /> MacLennan later reprised his role in season two of [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']].<ref name="JedhaKyberErso">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref>
